# 🎨 Logo Color Palette Document

This document serves as a reference for the color palette used in the Wings of Grace Logistics logo design. The colors are categorized into **Primary**, **Secondary**, and **Tertiary** colors, each with its respective Hex code, RGB, HSL values, and a brief description.

> 📌 **Important**
>  
> The colors listed below serve as a reference. **Official Brand Guidelines will supersede this palette.**
>

## Color Significance

- **Orange (#EB6F1B):** Energy, determination, and speed — embodies the brand’s drive for fast, reliable logistics.
- **Blue (#1B97EB):** Trust, professionalism, and stability — reinforces the dependable nature of services.
- **Black (#000000):** Strength, authority, and timeless sophistication — adds contrast and grounding to the brand.
- **White (#FFFFFF):** Purity, clarity, and simplicity — provides visual balance and ensures clean, professional brand presentation.
